name: Takamori Natsuki
source:
The protagonist. A boy.

A very kind and friendly person, but somewhat fearful and has low self-esteem. Pretty weak-willed, and will rely fully on someone else if they let him. After his older sister's death drove their mother to insanity, he took on her role, becoming "Natsuki" so as to not break his mother's heart. Was enrolled in Momoyuri Academy a few months later.

[translated from Getchu]
